content.title: Vince Williams Jr. - 2021-22 - Men's Basketball
content.text: Biography THE BASICS Physical, versatile wing who can play at the 3 or the 4; Left-handed Was the 41st-ranked small forward in the 2018 class, according to ESPN.com; Tabbed the 18th-best prospect in Ohio by 247Sports.com Chose VCU over Xavier, Wichita State, Richmond, Akron and others 2020-21 (JUNIOR) Named Third Team All-Atlantic 10 Conference Enjoyed healthiest campaign as a Ram and responded with career-highs of 10.6 points (second on the team) and 5.2 rebounds per game, the latter of which led the Rams Connected from beyond the 3-point arc at a .413 (43-of-103) clip, which ranked fifth in the conference; Shot .793 (65-of-82) from the free throw line Scored 10 or more points 16 times, including a career-high 19 in a critical A-10 win at Dayton on Feb. 9 Appeared in all 26 games, starting the final 22, and averaged 28.8 minutes per contest 2019-20 (SOPHOMORE) Appeared in 21 games, including three starts, despite hand and ankle injuries during the season Averaged 4.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 16.3 minutes per game; Collected 21 steals Enjoyed his best game of the season in a win over nationally ranked LSU (Nov. 13), providing 11 points, seven rebounds, three steals and a block Scored in double figures three times, including a season-high 13 points, as well as six rebounds, against nationally ranked Dayton (Feb. 18) Supplied seven points, seven rebounds and two assists at Richmond (Feb. 15) 2018-19 (FRESHMAN) Appeared in all 33 games off the bench for the Rams as a freshman and averaged 4.7 points and 3.3 rebounds in 15.4 minutes Ranked third on the team with 34 steals Scored a season-high 13 points and grabbed five rebounds against Charleston (Dec. 15) Provided 12 points and three boards in a victory over Bowling Green (Nov. 12) Hauled in a season-best nine rebounds and added six points and two steals in a win at Duquesne (Jan. 26) Dished out six assists to help lead the Rams to a win over Rider (Dec. 30) Provided six points, five assists, five rebounds and three steals in a road win at Richmond (March 2) PRIOR TO VCU Named Boys Player of the Year by the Toledo Blade three times, matching former Ohio State star William Buford; Led St. John’s Jesuit to a 90-17 record, including 54-2 in conference play, during his high school career Selected First Team All-Ohio as a junior and senior and Second Team All-Ohio as a sophomore; Named All-Northwest District three times, as well as District and TRAC Player of the Year twice Provided 19.6 points, 8.2 rebounds, 4.3 assists and 2.5 steals per game, while shooting 62 percent from the field and 75 percent from the line for the Titans as a senior; Led St. John’s Jesuit to a 23-4 mark and a Division I regional final appearance Averaged 16 points and 8.6 rebounds for St. John’s Jesuit as a junior Produced 12.2 points, 6.2 rebounds and 2.2 assists for the All-Ohio Red squad on the EYBL circuit in 2017 PERSONAL Full name: Vincent Terrill Williams Jr. Parents: Charlayne and Vincent Williams Birthdate: Aug. 30, 2000 Hometown: Toledo, Ohio Major: Interdisciplinary Studies Plans after basketball: Biologist Wears No. 10 because: “No reason”
